# markdown-it 15.0.2

`markdown-it.js` is the self-contained browser ESM bundle from the official
`markdown-it@15.0.2` npm package (`dist/browser/markdown-it.esm.min.mjs`), renamed
to `.js` for this site's static server. Only the source-map comment is removed.
The bundle is served locally so guides also work on static hosting without a CDN.

Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/markdown-it/-/markdown-it-15.0.2.tgz
Package SHA-1: `5bc092394e9693519f6d5f499d3575469fec62f3`

The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`; retain bundled license comments on updates.
Chat configuration and renderer overrides live in `public/rule-chat.js`.
